layers.process: At Kerehikapa research station in Arnavon Community Marine Park, Tourism Solomons lists three guest rooms and says catering for larger groups must be arranged at least 1–2 weeks in advance. Confirm availability and current arrangements with the park; the room count is not a cap on all visitors.
